summary: First-finish e2e smoke test of GeoPulse.Studio. Backend 6/7 endpoints pass (root, geocode, weather, air-quality, elevation, custom-layers CRUD). /api/pois returned 502 twice from public URL due to Overpass API slowness exceeding ingress timeout — backend logs confirm same endpoint returns 200 OK internally (Overpass fallback rotates through kumi.systems and private.coffee). Frontend fully functional: map + both sidebars render, layer toggles work, Show/Hide all works, search geocodes 'Times Square NYC' and drops pin with env stats populated (Temp 16.9°C, AQI 53, Elevation 122m), custom overlay upload via sample GeoJSON succeeds and appears in sidebar, basemap switch to Satellite visually confirmed, drop-pin button responsive. No console errors.
passed: GET /api/geocode?q=Times Square NYC -> 200, returns multiple lat/lon results
POST/GET/DELETE /api/custom-layers CRUD -> all 200 with proper id
Frontend loads with Layer Control sidebar + Proximity Analysis + Leaflet dark map
Show all / Hide all buttons toggle all layers correctly
Search flow: 'Times Square NYC' -> results list -> click result-0 -> pin placed, analysis center + env stats populated
Custom upload modal: use-sample + submit adds a custom layer visible in sidebar
Basemap selector -> Satellite option switches tiles (verified via screenshot)
Drop-pin button toggles pin-drop mode without error
Radius slider control rendered with data-testid='radius-value' text present

failed.issue: GET /api/pois returns 502 Bad Gateway from public URL (external Cloudflare/ingress). Reproduced twice with radius=1500 and radius=500. Backend logs show the same endpoint succeeds internally (200 OK) but Overpass upstream sometimes takes 30-90s across the fallback chain, exceeding external gateway timeout.
failed.evidence: curl to public /api/pois returns Cloudflare 502 HTML; backend.out.log shows '127.0.0.1 - GET /api/pois ... 200 OK' for the same request; frontend UI shows 'Fetching POIs...' spinner for ~30-60s after pin drop.

failed.issue: Radius slider keyboard interaction (focus + ArrowRight) did not change the displayed value (stayed at 1.50 km). Radix slider may need pointer drag or different keyboard focus. Slider is visible and functional visually; likely a test-script issue, not a product bug.
failed.evidence: radius-value text unchanged after 5x ArrowRight key presses

action_items: Investigate /api/pois timeout: consider reducing Overpass query timeout in backend (e.g., 20s per endpoint) and returning partial results with a 'partial: true' flag rather than trying all fallbacks sequentially, OR add server-side caching for common (lat,lon,radius,categories) tuples. Currently the sequential Overpass fallback chain can exceed the external ingress timeout, causing 502 for end users on first pin drop.
